build_DilatedResConv: build a PyTorch DilatedResConv module with configurable dilation, activation, and residual skip connections
create_Encoder: create an Encoder network with stacked dilated residual convolutions and average pooling for latent encoding
build_ZDiscriminator: build a ZDiscriminator network with 1D convolutions and ELU activations for latent space classification
run_cross_entropy_loss: run cross entropy loss computation on batched input logits and target class indices
review_Encoder_forward: review the Encoder forward pass that normalizes input, applies dilated convolutions, and pools to latent space
